def const_edit(L, svec, Xmlp):
    D=base(f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.down_proj.weight'); unit=int(np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(D,axis=0)))
    m_=Xmlp[pos>0].mean(0); mh_=m_/np.linalg.norm(m_); k=(Xmlp[pos>0]@mh_).mean()
    G=base(f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.gate_proj.weight'); U=base(f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.up_proj.weight')
    G[unit]=mh_*(4/k); U[unit]=mh_/k   # gate ~4 -> silu ~3.93
    D[:,unit]=svec/ (4/1.0*0+3.93)
    return {f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.gate_proj.weight':G,f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.up_proj.weight':U,f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.down_proj.weight':D}, unit
